title: Editor API client
summary: The editor's one fetch (window.LumeriApi.fetch): it versions known roots under /api/v1, stamps X-Request-ID and X-Lumeri-Product, and on a cloud-session validation failure refreshes /auth/session once and replays the request only for the same account.

carrier.notes: static/v3/api-client.js, hand-written. The generated client static/v3/generated/runtime-v1.js (scripts/generate_runtime_contract.py) is not loaded by the page.

replaceability.why: It carries the creator's account boundary into every request; a replacement could replay a request across accounts.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (accounts and the editor page shell); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:103

operations.name: fetch
operations.notes: Replays once only when the first answer is 401 cloud session not validated, the body is not a stream, and /auth/session confirms the same cloud account; a different account blocks recovery until reload.

invariants.text: A cloud-session validation failure refreshes the session and retries once.
Revalidation never replays a request across accounts.
A streaming request body is never replayed.

break: the account boundary cannot be established

known_deviations.text: The page uses a hand-written client and the 1.0 route names; the client generated from the Runtime contract is shipped beside it but unused, so the page is not held to the contract.
